description: This Java source file defines the RmiServiceContainer class, which implements a container for managing RMI services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles initialization, configuration, starting, and stopping of the RMI dispatcher, including setting up socket factories and binding to RMI registry or JNDI.

classes.name: RmiServiceContainer
classes.description: Implements a container for managing RMI-based services, including initialization, configuration, starting/stopping, and binding to RMI registry or JNDI.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with commands, name, and configuration file.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RMI service container, sets up socket factories, binds the dispatcher to RMI registry or JNDI based on configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the container by deregistering the remote dispatcher.
